ei.title: Traditional Nutrition Knowledge at Risk: A Call for Preservation

fullPassage: Many traditional populations have extensive understanding of nutritional issues from the field to the plate, including knowledge of the health and nutrition qualities of indigenous crop varieties. Knowledge of food preparation, combinations, processing, and preservation is an important part of the biocultural knowledge of many communities. Fermented foods are a good example. An in-depth review of indigenous peoples' food systems found that pride in local culture was one of the intervention strategies that improved health and nutrition among native people. All of this informs their individual choices. However, the migration of youth to urban centers in search of education and job opportunities is threatening the intergenerational knowledge transmission fundamental for the survival of these traditional food systems. Supporting and preserving this knowledge among rural and indigenous peoples is critical. If we don't, we'll lose it forever.

questions.passage: Many traditional populations have (A)[extensive / limited] understanding of nutritional issues from the field to the plate, including knowledge of the health and nutrition qualities of indigenous crop varieties. Knowledge of food preparation, combinations, processing, and preservation is an important part of the biocultural knowledge of many communities. Fermented foods are a good example. An in-depth review of indigenous peoples' food systems found that pride in local culture was one of the intervention strategies that (B)[improved / worsened] health and nutrition among native people. All of this informs their individual choices. However, the migration of youth to urban centers in search of education and job opportunities is (C)[threatening / supporting] the intergenerational knowledge transmission fundamental for the survival of these traditional food systems. Supporting and preserving this knowledge among rural and indigenous peoples is critical. If we don't, we'll lose it forever.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① extensive - improved - threatening: 전통 집단이 '광범위한' 이해를 갖고 있고, 자부심이 건강을 '향상시켰으며', 청년 이주가 전승을 '위협'한다는 원문.
❌ ② limited - improved - threatening: '제한된'은 extensive와 반대.
❌ ③ extensive - worsened - threatening: '악화시킨'은 improved와 반대.
❌ ④ extensive - improved - supporting: '지지하는'은 threatening과 반대.
det.tip: extensive(광범위한) ↔ limited(제한된). improve(향상) ↔ worsen(악화). threaten(위협) ↔ support(지지).

Knowledge of food (A)[preparation / consumption], combinations, processing, and preservation is an important part of the biocultural knowledge of many communities. Fermented foods are a good example. An in-depth review of indigenous peoples' food systems found that (B)[pride / shame] in local culture was one of the intervention strategies that improved health and nutrition among native people. All of this informs their individual choices. However, the migration of youth to urban centers in search of education and job opportunities is threatening the intergenerational knowledge transmission fundamental for the survival of these traditional food systems. (C)[Supporting / Abandoning] and preserving this knowledge among rural and indigenous peoples is critical. If we don't, we'll lose it forever.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ③ preparation - pride - Supporting: 음식 '준비' 지식, 지역 문화에 대한 '자부심', 지식을 '지지하고' 보존하기가 원문.
❌ ① consumption - pride - Supporting: '소비'는 preparation과 다른 의미.
❌ ② preparation - shame - Supporting: '수치심'은 pride와 반대.
❌ ④ preparation - pride - Abandoning: '포기하기'는 Supporting과 반대.
det.tip: preparation(준비) ↔ consumption(소비). pride(자부심) ↔ shame(수치심). support(지지) ↔ abandon(포기).

det.analysis:
✅ ② important - migration - lose: 지식이 '중요한' 부분이고, 청년의 '이주'가 위협이며, 보존하지 않으면 '잃게' 된다는 원문.

det.tip: important(중요한) ↔ trivial(사소한). migration(이주) ↔ settlement(정착). lose(잃다) ↔ keep(유지하다).
